Targeted official website/publication source checks and source-artwork comparison; see research notes for exact page scope.

Official city airport page and publication search checked. Downloaded 46-page November 2026 airport master-plan RFP: city Explore your TRAIL brand, not the distinct aircraft/airport signature. Existing 2024 destination-guide airport artwork remains raster evidence; no native airport source located.

Official home, merchandise and pilot pages inspected; roundel is Courtenay Airpark final logo JPG.jpg. Targeted plan/association searches locate municipal lease agendas, with no verified native airpark branding. No available brand-guide/source-vector link found.

Official homepage source uses raster logo.webp. Public WordPress media request returned 401 and was not pursued. Downloaded 2024 airport economic-viability RFP uses town branding. Baseline 2025 master plan uses consultant branding. No independent native airport signature found.

Official site and operational/newsletter publication leads inspected. Downloaded 2020 update yields the historical illustrated bitmap already delivered. 1998–99 newsletter is full-page raster scans, not native artwork.

Official PHS page fetch blocked, but public operator media results exposed 2016 and 2022 releases. Downloaded both: 2022 emblem is a 541 × 358 bitmap; 2016 identical layout is entirely native and yielded 56 outlined paths. Source blue differs, preserved as a separate 2016 colourway. Operator mark also serves other heliports.

Official header and airport documents checked. Downloaded strategic plan, March 2025 update and 2020 Asset Management Plan. AVRA branding remains bitmap; 2020 plan cover uses the regional district brand, not a separate airport vector. The 2024 financial-plan landscape emblem was already raster-verified in baseline.

Flying-club official site inspected. Targeted club/airport publication search returns the 2026 Kitimat council agenda carrying the same club badge already raster-verified in baseline. This is operator identity; no standalone native airport mark verified.

Official home/about pages and public WordPress logo/PDF media results inspected. Five logo results are PNG. Newly downloaded 2025 fees, 2024 groundside pilot-lounge sheet and 2024 land lease use bitmaps. Stacked 2024 layout extracted separately. Earlier 2017 eagle raster already delivered. Boleyn portfolio is a source lead, not a verified native logo pack.

Official annual-report index and reports 2003–2010, 2012–2017, 2023 inspected. Eight native SVG additions and one blue historical raster extracted. 2018–2021 reports were not downloaded in this pass; 2022/2024/2025 source findings are from baseline.

Official home and document leads inspected. Community-engagement PDF contains bitmap mountain/CYCW logo. Safari pinned-tab SVG is a generic landing-plane favicon, visually unlike the airport mark, and was rejected. BCAC 2018 guide p39 repeats an airport bitmap.

Official airport page, 2024 funding request and 2023 master-plan landing page inspected. Downloaded entire 80-page 2023 plan and inspected its logo image objects. HM consultant art is distinct; actual airport mark on maps and survey p76 is bitmap. The earlier 400 × 237 wing/script lockup is delivered separately. November 2025 letterhead remains a source lead not retrieved.

Official home and business page source inspected. Airport signature is PNG within Wix; inline SVG/UI assets are not the signature. Targeted airport/pilot publication searches returned operational-chart leads, not a verified logo master.
Official city transport page/homepage inspected. YDQ text and municipal branding are present; baseline unreleased-brand project is not treated as an adopted identity.
Official homepage/guide direct fetches blocked. Baseline already inspected 2025 v6.1 guide p11/15 and found 12 embedded bitmaps; not rescanned here.

Official airport homepage source inspected. Targeted branding/publication search returns the 2022 ACBC presentation and 2024 press material already raster-verified in baseline. City airport page points to presentation material. No new native logo pack or matching SVG located.

Official home, authority, history and fees pages inspected; all use YPR_Logo.png. Public logo media search returned no results. Baseline advertising PDF remains raster evidence. No source-native file or brand guide verified.

Official city airport page and 2013 asset-management-plan search evidence reviewed. It uses the City of Powell River identity; no separate native airport logo verified. No new airport artwork proposed.

Official homepage inspected: illustrated JPEG airport banner; inline SVGs are UI icons. Targeted society/airport publication searches found no separate source-native airport mark. Recent village lease material uses municipal branding.
Official homepage checked and 2004 annual report downloaded; report is scanned raster. Existing native logo variants retained.

Official airport page and targeted plan/brand search checked. 2015 business-plan/council PDF is the same raster source retained in baseline. No new standalone vector source or official vector download verified.

Official homepage and public logo media query returned HTTP 406. Targeted airport/association and publication searches did not locate a verifiable guide, report, SVG or EPS. Existing official PNG remains baseline evidence; source bytes for potential additional originals were unavailable.
Official 2007 and 2014 reports downloaded; 2007 back cover gives native white Beyond, Every Day lockup. 2014 report cover is raster. Other baseline vector retained.

Official homepage returned 403. Downloaded 2020 Cranbrook investment brochure p8 has a 209 × 59 airport bitmap. Search located 2007 city annual report and June 2024 airport advertising guide; both direct URLs returned 404. Existing city advertising source is raster-verified in baseline. New designer credit is Genex Marketing; no source logo pack verified.

Downloaded Vantage ESG 2021 report p32: airport logo 290 × 74 bitmap. AVOP 2021 p1: 429 × 108 bitmap. Vantage location profile has no airport logo. Council-hosted transition letter carries a distinct Airport Society bitmap, not native geometry; its printed 2027 date is not evidence of a historical airport rebrand. Official primary signature remains PNG.
Official media page says vector artwork is available by request. 2024 annual report downloaded: full-colour cover logo is 185×87 raster. No messages sent.
Official homepage direct fetch blocked. Baseline vector/rasters retained; no additional source bytes inspected.

Official header, advertising, investment and logo-search pages use PNG. Newly downloaded 2011 expansion release (2 pages) and 2016 aerospace-cluster release (2 pages) embed airport-logo bitmaps. BCAC 2018 guide p39 and 2023 Silver Wings sponsor slide p70 also use bitmaps. Existing 2024/2026 PDF findings remain baseline. Academic redesign portfolios were excluded as unadopted.

Downloaded 2014 investment brochure and 2026 development flyer. 2014 alphorn raster already delivered; 2026 airport mark is embedded at 800 × 647 and 468 × 305, not native geometry. Official source and search did not yield a logo master.
Official homepage unavailable in direct retrieval; Rhubarb portfolio inspected and previews are raster. No source-native airport logo recovered.

Official microsite home, business and pilot page sources inspected; YYF map-pin signature is PNG. Both published December 2020 pilot and site maps were downloaded and inspected: thousands of native CAD paths, but federal identification and no YYF logo. Transport Canada page uses federal identity. No native pin/YYF logo master found.

Official site fetch returned 403. Search located airport newsletter, accessibility plan, rules/manual and event forms. Downloaded AAP and rules PDFs show raster Alpha Aviation operator marks; newsletter is PNG. Effective FBO SVG and airshow/vendor logos are not the airport signature.
